subject: DPA request / subprocessors / execution preference — ProspectCo
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prospectco.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@prospectco.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: DPA request & subprocessors — Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well. We are starting vendor intake for the upcoming integration and need to get a Data Processing Agreement in place before the technical kickoff. Could you send our team: 

- Redwood's current DPA template (including any standard annexes),
- a current list of subprocessors and their processing purposes, and
- your preferred execution method (DocuSign or Adobe Sign).

A few specific asks from our side:
- Confirmation of lawful transfer mechanisms for EU personal data (SCCs or UK Addendum etc.),
- Whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS) for encrypted payloads, and
- Commitment window for notifying us of new subprocessors (we typically request 30 days notice; our legal team will flag if that needs to be 90).

Procurement has asked for a signed DPA by EOD Jan 20 to keep the onboarding timeline. If a direct phone call helps to accelerate, we can coordinate.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
ProspectCo
samira.khan@prospectco.com
+1 415-555-0198

(Attachment: none)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prospectco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA request & subprocessors — Redwood Inference

Hi Samira —

Great to hear from you. Thanks for the timeline. I've attached our current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf) and our up-to-date subprocessors list (redwood_subprocessors_202601.pdf). Short answers to your bullets below: 

- Transfers: We rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with the UK Addendum where applicable; we can provide the executed SCCs language in the DPA annex.
- KMS: We offer customer-managed keys for certain enterprise configurations (Private deployments and Dedicated customers). For hosted accounts we currently manage keys; we can raise an exception if ProspectCo requires KMS as a contractual requirement — that would be a deployment/ops conversation.
- Subprocessor notice: Our standard is 30 days notice for new subprocessors; we can consider a 90‑day notice in your contract depending on the subprocessor category (e.g., analytics vs. infrastructure).

If you prefer, we can sign via DocuSign (we have an envelope-ready DPA) — happy to use Adobe Sign if that's your procurement standard.

I'll loop in Marissa and Soojin from Legal/Privacy to review any redlines you return.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf; redwood_subprocessors_202601.pdf)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prospectco.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@prospectco.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:51:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA request & subprocessors — Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick send. Attached are our redlines and a couple of substantive items we need clarity on (ProspectCo_DPA_redlines.docx):

- We redlined the data transfer clause to explicitly include SCCs + reference to the UK Addendum and a process for on-demand audit evidence.
- We requested a contractual commitment for 90 days' notice for material new subprocessors.
- One subprocessor in your list, "CloudX Monitoring Services", is flagged by our InfoSec team — can you confirm the processing purpose and whether it sees any unredacted payloads?
- We'd prefer DocuSign for execution. I've prepared an envelope and can send once we confirm the subprocessor scope; provisional link below.

DocuSign provisional envelope: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0X9AB

Can Marissa or Soojin confirm whether Redwood can accept the 90-day notification or propose alternative language? If you cannot make the KMS commitment for hosted, please note that as a blocking item for us and we will route for an exceptions process with procurement.

Best,
Samira
(Attachment: ProspectCo_DPA_redlines.docx)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA request & subprocessors — Redwood Inference

Karthik / Soojin — forwarding Samira's redlines. Quick notes from Legal: 

- SCCs + UK Addendum: fine to accept as-is in the annex; we typically attach the standard textual SCCs and include a reference clause rather than embedding the full text in the body.
- 90‑day notice: our policy is 30 days. For ProspectCo I recommend we accept a 90-day notice for "material" subprocessors only (infrastructure/security/monitoring) and keep 30 days for other categories. Suggest language: "90 days' notice for material subprocessors; 30 days for routine service providers."
- CloudX Monitoring Services: privacy informs me CloudX only receives aggregated telemetry for availability/health; no unredacted customer payloads. Confirmed by infra. We should give a short purpose statement in the subprocessor schedule and mark CloudX as "monitoring".
- KMS: as Karthik noted, hosted customers do not currently get customer-managed keys. If ProspectCo requires KMS we can offer Dedicated or Private deployment as an alternative; recommend proposing that to procurement as an option.

Action items:
1) Karthik to confirm we can include the proposed 90/30 split language and the short CloudX purpose statement in the subprocessor schedule.
2) Soojin to prepare final DPA with SCC annex and redline acceptance and a note re: KMS / deployment options.
3) Karthik to accept DocuSign envelope once legal signs off.

Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Internal)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prospectco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA request & subprocessors — Redwood Inference

Samira —

Thanks and appreciate the clear redlines. Per our internal review: 

- We can accept SCCs + UK Addendum in the annex.
- We will adopt the 90/30 notice split: 90 days for material subprocessors (infrastructure, security, monitoring), 30 days otherwise. We'll add that clause to the subprocessor schedule.
- CloudX Monitoring Services: confirmed purpose in subprocessor schedule as "aggregated availability and health telemetry; no access to unredacted customer content."
- KMS: hosted customers do not have customer-managed keys; if ProspectCo requires KMS we can support via Dedicated or Private deployment — I'll include that in the email thread to procurement.

I have routed the final DPA through Legal and they've applied the agreed changes. The DPA has been executed via DocuSign; see attached DocuSign_Envelope_0X9AB.pdf (execution confirmation). Final signed DPA and subprocessor schedule are stored here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Redwood/DPAs/ProspectCo and I've recorded the deal in HubSpot (12345).

If you need anything else to unblock the kickoff, let me know and we can jump on a brief call this week.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: DocuSign_Envelope_0X9AB.pdf)
